project_scope.note: Approved B010 Dalea set. Species identification emphasizes growth form, leaflet architecture, spike/head density, and calyx characters rather than flower color.

shared_traits: small flowers arranged in spikes or headlike clusters
study_strategy.warning: Do not identify Dalea from flower color alone. D. compacta vs D. purpurea especially requires calyx-level confirmation.

quick_key.if: low intricately branched woody shrub + many tiny leaflets + short spikes
few larger silky leaflets + densely fuzzy head
long slender loose spike with separated flowers/bracts
narrow linear leaflets + dense swollen cylindrical/ovoid head
